# @favy/di

> @favy/di v3 is a dependency injection library for TypeScript 5.0 or newer, built from typed named functions without decorators or container configuration.

`Module` creates a callable with explicit dependencies and an inferred result. Its defaults are `lazy: true` and `cache: 'run'`: resolve providers on first access and reuse their values within one top-level call. Declare `type FooLive = typeof Foo.Live` immediately below each module. This combines the module's provided value with its dependencies, carrying transitive requirements through the graph. `.Live` is a type-only marker; reading it at runtime throws. The exported `Live<typeof Foo>` helper remains equivalent. The API reference is authoritative for exports and signatures.

## Core documentation

- [Introduction](https://di.favy.dev/guides/introduction/): Installation, first modules, and the composition root.
- [Module](https://di.favy.dev/module/module/): Named callables, dependency contracts, and composition with `typeof Foo.Live`.
- [API Reference](https://di.favy.dev/reference/api/): Public exports, signatures, and runtime semantics.
- [Partial Application](https://di.favy.dev/module/partial/): Bind dependencies with `.provide()` and preserve remaining requirements.
- [Caching](https://di.favy.dev/module/cache/): Per-run, factory-wide, and disabled caching.
- [Lazy Initialization](https://di.favy.dev/module/lazy/): Resolve providers on demand or eagerly.
- [Generator modules](https://di.favy.dev/module/generator/): `Tag<Service>()(key)` separates a service contract from its implementation. `GenModule<Deps>()(tag, function* (deps) { ... })` checks the implementation; `yield* tag` infers only the service requirement. Fully bind implementation dependencies with `.provide()` before root wiring. Named generator modules and transitive inference via `yield* module` remain supported. Synchronous generators can return services with async methods; ordinary modules remain non-iterable.

## Guides

- [Testing](https://di.favy.dev/guides/testing/): Replace dependencies with typed fakes and manage cache state.
- [Best Practices](https://di.favy.dev/guides/best-practices/): Organize modules, choose lifetimes, and handle errors at boundaries.

## Optional

- [Playground](https://di.favy.dev/playground/): Multi-file React, browser Request/Response, and Tag/GenModule projects with a file tree, TypeScript editor, live preview, and console. Select projects with ?example=react-orders, http-handler, or generator-services. Run executes a snapshot; Stop removes it. Drafts persist in the current tab.
- [Basic snippets](https://di.favy.dev/playground/basics/): Six focused @favy/di examples with editable TypeScript and console output.
- [Transform Input](https://di.favy.dev/module/transform-input/): Customize callback dependencies and module metadata.
- [Transform Output](https://di.favy.dev/module/transform-output/): Observe or transform successful module results.
- [HKT support](https://di.favy.dev/reference/api/#hkt): Compute input and output types with higher-kinded transformations.
- [Source repository](https://github.com/favyorg/di): Implementation, examples, and contributor information.
